snippet_primary: "Unlike Etsy, which charges $0.20 per listing every four months, Amazon lets you list as many products as you want for free. You only pay when something sells. Amazon charges a flat 15% referral fee on every sale. This is much higher than Etsy's 6.5% transaction fee. While Amazon's fee includes payment processing, the total cost per sale is still significantly higher."
